defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rider's Bond
defensiveAbilities.description: Bloodwing acts on Molog's initiative while Molog is mounted. Molog automatically succeeds at attempts to Command her and doesn't need to spend actions to do so, but Bloodwing only has two actions per turn as long as Molog is mounted.

defensiveAbilities.name: Savage
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature Grabbed by Bloodwing critically fails a skill check to Escape

Effect Bloodwing makes a stinger Strike against the triggering creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Powerful Dive
offensiveAbilities.description: Bloodwing Flies up to her fly Speed and must both move forward at least 20 feet and descend at least 10 feet. If she ends the movement within melee reach of at least one enemy her size or smaller, she can make a claw Strike against that enemy. If the claw hits, as a free action Bloodwing can either automatically Grab the target or knock it Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Punishing Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Bloodwing Grabbed a creature this turn using Powerful Dive

Effect Bloodwing can Fly at half Speed while holding the creature in her claws, carrying that creature along with her and dropping it at the end of her movement. Alternatively, Bloodwing can Strike the creature with her stinger with a +2 circumstance bonus.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wyvern Poison
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 3d6 Poison Damage damage plus Sickened 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 3d8 Poison Damage damage plus Sickened 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d10 Poison Damage damage plus Sickened 3 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
